Scarce authority on standards and procedures

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk in NDT is not AI but remaining at entry-level interpretation. AI is absorbing low-level repetitive review, while Level III specialists who define procedures and sign reports become scarcer because of their safety responsibility.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but the dual pressure of responsibility and safety. Inspection conclusions directly affect equipment and personal safety, one misjudgment can cause an accident, and signing responsibility is extremely heavy. Radiographic testing also carries radiation exposure, elevated and confined-space work carries safety risks, and strict credential systems make certification a firm threshold.
risks: Major responsibility: one misjudgment can cause an accident
Safety exposure: radiation, heights, and confined environments
Certification threshold: level determines the income ceiling
Demanding field conditions: frequent travel and outdoor work
AI substitution: entry-level interpretation roles are declining

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can flag a suspicious point on a radiograph in one second, but a certified specialist must bear the signed responsibility for deciding whether it is a crack or normal geometric reflection and whether the weld should be released.

responsibilities: Operate inspection equipment to complete field testing
Maintain equipment and implement safety protection
skills: Ultrasonic / radiographic / magnetic-particle and other testing technologies
Waveform and image interpretation and analysis
Application of inspection standards and specifications

career_path_block.路径: 技术负责人/实验室主管

career_risk_cards.callout: 无损检测最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在初级判读」——AI 正在吃掉的正是低等级重复判读，而能定工艺、会签字的 III 级检测师，反而因为安全责任变得更稀缺。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「责任与安全的双重压力」：检测结论直接关系设备与人身安全，误判一次可能酿成事故，签字责任极重；同时射线检测有辐射风险、高空与密闭空间作业有安全风险，证照体系严格，持证是硬门槛。
risks: 责任重大：误判一次可能出事故
安全暴露：辐射、高空、密闭环境
证书门槛：等级决定收入天花板
现场辛苦：出差与野外作业多
AI 替代：初级判读岗位在减少

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能在一秒里标出底片上的可疑点，但「这是裂纹还是正常的几何反射、这条焊缝该不该放行」——这份要签字、要负责的判断，永远得由持证检测师来承担。

responsibilities: 操作检测设备完成现场检测
分析数据并评定缺陷等级
维护设备与执行安全防护
skills: 超声/射线/磁粉等检测技术

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but remaining an operator without learning technical skills. As automation spreads, support workers who interpret monitoring data, understand equipment, and handle emergencies become more important.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is not AI, but underground safety and industry volatility. Roof accidents are dangerous, underground conditions are harsh, and industry demand fluctuates with commodity prices. AI and automated bolters replace some drilling, but people still assess roofs, adapt to complex conditions, and respond to emergencies, making certified experienced workers more secure.
risks: High underground safety risks and responsibility
Industry demand fluctuates with commodity prices
Harsh underground environment and health risks
Automation reduces staffing and contracts jobs
Narrower entry pathways and credential-dependent advancement

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can automatically monitor roof separation and predict ground-pressure risk, but experienced underground workers still provide drilling feel and intuition when a roof begins to creak. You hold up the space above underground workers' heads, and machines cannot replace that responsibility for safety.

responsibilities: Inspect roofs and confirm support plans

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只当操作工不学技术」——会看监测数据、懂设备、能应急的支护工人，自动化越普及越重要。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「井下作业的安全性与行业波动」——顶板事故风险高、井下环境艰苦，行业景气随矿价波动。AI 与自动化锚杆机正在替代部分钻孔作业，但顶板判断、复杂工况应变和应急处理靠人，持证的老工人更稳。
risks: 井下安全风险高，责任大
行业景气随矿价波动
井下环境艰苦，健康风险
自动化减人，岗位收缩
入行渠道收窄，晋升依赖资质

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动监测顶板离层、预判矿压风险，但钻孔的手感、顶板「吱吱响」时的直觉，还得靠井下老师傅。你撑住的是井下工人头顶的一片天，这份安全，机器替代不了。

responsibilities: 检查顶板并确认支护方案
操作钻机钻孔安装锚杆
施加预应力并调整参数

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Water And Wastewater Treatment Plant And System Operators lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this role is not AI but medium-risk exposure combined with scope of responsibility. Judgment and final review for Water And Wastewater Treatment Plant And System Operators still rest with people; AI only handles structurable tasks.
risks: Pressure from accountability and compliance boundaries in water and wastewater treatment.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split moderate risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute water-treatment work plans.
Take responsibility for the quality and risks of water-treatment outcomes.
Coordinate resources and drive delivery of water-treatment projects.
Review and improve water-treatment processes and methods.

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——给排水处理厂与系统操作员的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「中风险敞口 + 责任边界」——给排水处理厂与系统操作员的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Water And Wastewater Treatment Plant And System Operators领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把中风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but completion plus low-code tools. Systems take simple pages, while developers with architecture skills become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is not AI but code completion plus low-code tools. They accelerate routine pages and simple logic, but people still handle architectural judgment, experience refinement, and complex business needs.
risks: Low-code tools take routine pages
Completion replaces routine work
Requirements change quickly
Compatibility work is tedious
Technology changes quickly

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, developers still choose reliable architectures, refine experiences, and decompose complex logic. They must think, write, and visually debug; people cannot be fully removed from the product's public face.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「补全 + 低代码」——简单页面被系统吃，有架构力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「代码补全 + 低代码」——常规页面与简单逻辑被提速，但架构判断、体验打磨与复杂业务仍要人。
risks: 低代码吃常规页
补全替代
需求变更快
兼容琐碎
技术更新快

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪套架构靠谱、体验怎么打磨、复杂逻辑怎么拆，最后还是开发的脑去想、手去写、眼去调——门面这头，人撤不干净。
